justification: Both surfaces show animal or animal-human hybrid figures in profile within a bordered field, but the specifics differ entirely: A has large-scale, densely feathered winged genii/griffin-demon with raised arms and detailed scale and feather infill filling the whole panel, while B shows a small horse-like quadruped with a rider or attendant above a broad zone of interlaced ribbon knotwork, framed by a band of repeated linear signs. The only correspondences (an animal in profile, a border) are of the generic kind any tradition could produce independently; there is no shared distinctive motif or relationship.
